headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance announced a plan to remove about 750,000 people from Affordable Care Act plans in an effort to crack down on alleged healthcare fraud. NBC News’ Garrett Haake details why the administration is doing this now.

headlines.title: Expert Tips for Thriving While on GLP-1 Medications
headlines.description: Heidi Skolnik, a sports nutritionist, exercise physiologist and bestselling author, joins TODAY to discuss her latest book, “Your GLP-1 Game Plan,” that is filled with guidance on what to eat and how to move and thrive on weight loss medications. “The medication doesn’t give you nourishment, and it doesn’t give you strength. You really need to go beyond the scale to think about your ‘why.’ And we know that when you focus on health beyond appearance, you do better,” she says.

headlines.title: Hundreds of lawsuits filed against some GLP-1 Makers over vision loss
headlines.description: Hundreds of Americans are suing GLP-1 drugmakers Novo Nordisk and Ely Lilly, saying they were not adequately warned of the potential danger of vision loss. In statements, Novo Nordisk says, in part, they are “vigorously” fighting the lawsuits, saying they are “without merit,” while Eli Lilly says in part, it maintains “patient safety” is its “top priority.” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

headlines.title: Why are Americans so tired so often? New CDC report highlights who’s feeling it most
headlines.description: About 71% of of adults in the U.S. say they experience fatigue, a new report from the CDC found. Women and younger adults are feeling it most often.
